isolation_disclaimer: 策略级，非 OS 沙箱；实际隔离未实现/未声称。目录 allowlist 与拒绝逻辑不等同于容器、namespaces、seccomp、capabilities 或跨用户权限隔离。

allowed.check_method: Path.resolve() must equal the run directory or be below it; attempt request/response files additionally require exclusive create mode.

denied.value: ALL paths outside the run directory allowlist
denied.check_method: resolved-path containment check before any runner read or write
exclusive mkdir plus open(..., 'x') for request evidence; never truncate an existing attempt

denied.value: ALL sockets, remote hosts, downloads and web calls
denied.check_method: policy category is denied before mock transport; runner imports no networking modules
sealed category is denied before access; authority_map sealed root remains UNRESOLVED

denied.value: production model endpoints, services and deployment surfaces
denied.check_method: production category is denied before any transport

denied.value: PostgreSQL, PGVector and all database connections
denied.check_method: database category is denied before any transport

denied.value: all training runs and model fitting
denied.check_method: training is outside the mock action vocabulary and remains disallowed by the T3 policy
denied.refusal_evidence_format: unknown action/category fails closed and preserves the unexpected-crash evidence

denied.check_method: runner executes only locally and denies network before mock transport
denied.refusal_evidence_format: policy_rejections entry with network_used=false and transport_called=false

unverified_surfaces: seccomp, AppArmor, SELinux or capability confinement
production, training, database or real model endpoint behavior
